UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_enabled_too: Highlights only loose items currently visible to your character.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_color_toolt: Choose the highlight color. The default is yellow-orange.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_toggle_key_: Press this key in game to enable or disable highlighting.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_radius_tool: Search radius in tiles. Highlights loose items on loaded tiles around the player.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_tools_tooltip: Survivor Toolkit: wishlists, menu rules and settings.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_button_tooltip: Click to toggle item highlights. Shortcut: %1. Change it in Options > Mods > PZ Survivor Toolkit.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_media_windo: TV & Radio ReInvented: inventory and outside clicks keep the window open; use the close button. Disable to restore the original behavior.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_sidebar_but: Show the item-highlight toggle in the left sidebar. You can still use the shortcut or Mod Options when hidden.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_clothing_ne: Show zero protection changes in grey
Use neutral grey for zero changes in the Wear menu. Disable to keep the original game colours.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_vhs_control: Click a loaded tape to eject it. Select tapes from reachable containers or drag them onto the slot. Fully watched tapes have the inventory checkmark.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_vhs_slot_tooltip: Click to select a VHS from your inventory or nearby containers. Drag a VHS here to insert it. Click a loaded tape to eject it.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_inventory_f: Select a category beside the Category heading. CleanUI searches show only matches; no matches show an empty list. Bulk transfers respect the visible items.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_disman: Adds a bulk dismantle command for selected watches and other electronics. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Uses normal recipes, tools, time and XP.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_remove: Adds bulk removal using the native Remove Battery recipe. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Devices remain intact; batteries retain their charge.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_unload: Queues native unloading for selected loaded magazines and firearms with integral magazines. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Does not eject detachable magazines or rack chambers.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_remove: Queues native removal of every detachable part from selected weapons. Respects native tool requirements; skips favourites and worn/held items.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_remove_attachments_: Remove all parts from selected weapons (%1)
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_sy: Show six medicine effects from authoritative server readings in multiplayer. Lemongrass shows an estimated maximum cooldown. Disable to hide these indicators.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_he: Show active herbal pain relief (black sage) and cold relief (common mallow), including dried herbs.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_pending: The medicine needs some time to take effect
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_navigator_t: Preserves Navigator's original textured housing and fits its tint and position to vanilla and Realistic Dashboard panels. Follows dashboard size; keeps text and buttons readable. Disable to restore Navigator's original appearance.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_quantity: Transfer a chosen number of items
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_quantity_to: Adds Grab amount / Put amount. The integer limit applies to the entire selection. Uses native transfers.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_uninstall_g: Adds Uninstall to ground beside native Uninstall. Disable to hide the additional action; queued removals finish normally.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_quantity_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and %1.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_toolt: Native action queue with icons. Click an operation header cross to cancel its waiting steps together. Drag operations with their preparation and item returns; drop above supported current work to interrupt and resume it afterwards.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_cancel_tip: Cancel only this action and keep the rest of the native queue.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_dependent: Protected: preparation, restoration or an unverified dependency/callback. Use the operation header cross when available.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_active: This running action cannot be stopped independently. Native item transactions and craft callbacks must finish normally.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_starting: Wait until this action has started. A finishing action cannot be cancelled.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_stopping: Waiting for the game to stop the current action.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_unavailable: This action is no longer available.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_drag_tip: Drag to reorder an operation with its preparation. Drop above reading or dismantling to interrupt and resume; building supports this in single-player. Use the mouse wheel to scroll.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_active: A running operation cannot be moved. Drop another operation above supported reading, dismantling or single-player building to interrupt it. Reading keeps saved pages; unfinished world work restarts after the urgent operation.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_dependen: This operation is still adding steps or its linked steps are separated in the queue.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_context_tooltip: Groups known actions and removes exact duplicates. Common actions appear above secondary/destructive commands, with different priorities for carried items, loot, world and vehicles. Uses fixed purpose-based defaults, not click tracking. Native selectors and manual placements are preserved.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_context_editor_tool: Optional: change groups for discovered actions, keep them at the root, hide them or restore automatic rules. Settings are local to this client.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_context_empty: Open context menus in game to discover their actions.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_shared_i: These operations use the same item. Keep their order so the item stays available.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_group: Moves all %1 remaining steps together, including preparation and item returns.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_expand_tip: Click + to show each step and its cancel control. Counts include preparation and item returns.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_collapse_tip: Click - to hide the individual steps. Drag beside this control to move the whole operation.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_shared_b: Another copy of the same book shares reading progress. Keep it after the current read.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_cut_cl: Adds batch cutting/ripping for selected cotton, denim and leather clothing. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Uses native tools, recipes, time and outputs.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_cancel_operat: Cancel this operation, stop its remaining work and return borrowed items; keep the rest of the queue.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_operation_act: This active step cannot be safely interrupted. Wait for it to finish.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_operation_dep: Protected: unknown callbacks, separated linked steps, or another action may depend on this operation.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_operation_sha: Protected: an action outside this operation uses the same item.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_world_tr: Started construction in multiplayer must finish: the server may already have spent its materials. Waiting construction can still be reordered or cancelled.
UI_PZST_CraftChainOptionTooltip: Adds a reviewable plan in native crafting and Neat Crafting. Intermediate recipes run as normal actions. Disable to hide planning controls.
UI_PZST_CraftChainButtonTooltip: Plan this recipe and any supported intermediate recipes using reachable items.
UI_PZST_CraftChainExplanation: Review the order and materials below. Tools and ingredients are checked again before each step. Missing items or a native interruption can stop the remaining queue.
UI_PZST_CraftChainReviewChanged: The plan changed. Review it, then queue it again to confirm.
UI_PZST_CraftChainmissing: No supported chain found with the available items. One missing requirement: %1. Some recipes need tools, skills, a known recipe or a nearby surface.
UI_PZST_CraftChaincomplex: The plan exceeds the search or inventory limit. Try fewer crafts or make some intermediates first.
UI_PZST_CraftChainUnsupportedCallbacks: This recipe uses custom callbacks or continuous processing; use ordinary crafting.
UI_PZST_CraftChainUnsupportedOutputs: This recipe has variable, random or special outputs that cannot be planned safely.
UI_PZST_CraftChainUnsupportedInputs: This recipe uses fluids, partial item uses or special inputs that cannot be planned yet.
UI_PZST_CraftChainUnsupportedSelection: This manual selection cannot be planned. Select one item type per input or use ordinary crafting.
UI_PZST_CraftChainUnavailable: This recipe or character is no longer available here. Check the selected recipe, skills and crafting surface.
UI_PZST_CraftChainChanged: Crafting stopped: the planned ingredients, tools or crafting conditions changed.
UI_PZST_CraftChainChoiceScope: Click to choose a material. Applies to this ingredient in every use of this recipe in the plan. Missing materials may need prerequisite crafting.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_queue_move_craft_in: This operation chooses ingredients when it runs. Reordering could change which items are consumed.
